authority: CEO Round 156: 'Competitor intelligence must generate experiments. Suppose the engine learns: VIEshunt has strong acute control but no public evidence of long-horizon degradation prediction. The next step should not simply be: C2-Y looks differentiated. It should generate: C2-Y-R1: longest-horizon latent-degradation experiment. Likewise for C3-X and C5-X. This turns competitive intelligence directly into scientific work.'
constitutional_basis: Article I — evidence precedes assertion (competitive intelligence is hypothesis; experiment is evidence)
Article XIV — no research proceeds through a red gate (if experiment fails, candidate is KILLED)
Article XXVIII — no silent semantic promotion (competitive differentiation ≠ experimental validation)
Article XXXII — state strongest alternative (incumbent may have undisclosed capability)
Article XXXV — closed-loop epistemic control (experiments generate evidence that updates the model)

the_translation_rule.rule: Every competitor capability gap (NO_PUBLIC_EVIDENCE of capability) generates a candidate experiment that tests whether our invention fills that gap.
the_translation_rule.important_caveat: Filling a publicly-known gap does NOT prove novelty — the incumbent may have undisclosed R&D that fills the same gap (Article XXXII). The experiment proves OUR invention works; it does NOT prove the incumbent CANNOT do the same.

C2_Y_R1.competitor_intelligence: VIEshunt has strong acute control (DEMONSTRATED) but no public evidence of long-horizon degradation prediction (UNKNOWN — correct language per Article XXV).
C2_Y_R1.correct_response: Generate C2-Y-R1: longest-horizon latent-degradation experiment. Test whether C2-Y's response-manifold deviation provides lead time BEFORE UISB baseline (VIEshunt-like control + Nature-like sensor + Codman threshold).
C2_Y_R1.key_innovation_tested: Long-horizon latent degradation prediction from response-manifold deviation
C2_Y_R1.what_success_proves: C2-Y provides lead-time advantage over strongest publicly plausible incumbent combination.
C2_Y_R1.what_success_does_NOT_prove: That VIEshunt's commercializer or Medtronic cannot internally develop similar prediction (Article XXXII).
C2_Y_R1.what_failure_proves: C2-Y does not provide lead-time advantage → KILL C2-Y → update discovery queue.
C2_Y_R1.intermediate_outcome: If C2-Y provides 4-24h lead time → INCONCLUSIVE → tighten experiment or public KILL (Article XXXIII).
C2_Y_R1.prerequisite: UISB baseline reproduction within 20% of VIEshunt-published response (Article XXIX).

C3_X_R1.competitor_intelligence: ThecaFlex provides intrathecal access (DEMONSTRATED) but no publicly demonstrated closed-loop dosing (UNKNOWN — correct language per Article XXV). Standard-of-care Bayesian TDM (DEMONSTRATED in adjacent areas) is the strongest plausible adaptive baseline.
C3_X_R1.naive_response: C3-X looks differentiated because ThecaFlex is open-loop → promote C3-X.
C3_X_R1.correct_response: Generate C3-X-R1: adaptive dosing under patient variability. Test whether C3-X's CSF-state-feedback provides measurable therapeutic advantage over BOTH ThecaFlex-style open-loop AND best-practicable Bayesian adaptive TDM.
C3_X_R1.primary_endpoint: drug_concentration_stability_in_therapeutic_window (fraction of patient-time in therapeutic range + CV)
C3_X_R1.key_innovation_tested: Continuous CSF-state-feedback dosing vs weekly-sampled Bayesian TDM
C3_X_R1.what_success_proves: C3-X provides therapeutic advantage over strongest publicly plausible open-loop AND adaptive baselines.
C3_X_R1.what_success_does_NOT_prove: That Biogen cannot internally develop closed-loop dosing for ThecaFlex (Article XXXII).
C3_X_R1.what_failure_proves: C3-X does not provide advantage over Baseline B → KILL C3-X → update discovery queue.
C3_X_R1.intermediate_outcome: If C3-X beats Baseline A but not Baseline B → INCONCLUSIVE → tighten experiment or public KILL.
C3_X_R1.prerequisite: Baseline A and Baseline B reproduction within 15% of published PK data (Article XXIX).

C5_X_R1.competitor_intelligence: Existing thrombus digital twins predict fragmentation (DEMONSTRATED academic) but have NOT demonstrated independent multi-world validation (UNKNOWN — most use single solver) or intervention benefit (UNKNOWN — most report AUROC only).
C5_X_R1.naive_response: C5-X looks differentiated because no one has done multi-world validation → promote C5-X.
C5_X_R1.correct_response: Generate C5-X-R1: cross-world reproducibility + intervention benefit. Test whether C5-X beats three public baselines (physics-only, data-driven, physics+ML) on AUROC AND decision benefit AND survives clotFoam independent reproduction.
C5_X_R1.primary_endpoint: decision_benefit_under_intervention_budget (reduction in embolic-risk events under fixed intervention budget)
C5_X_R1.key_innovation_tested: Validated precursor (survives clotFoam) + patient-specific twin + intervention optimization
C5_X_R1.what_success_proves: C5-X provides decision benefit over strongest publicly plausible combination of physics + data-driven + physics+ML approaches, with independent reproduction.
C5_X_R1.what_success_does_NOT_prove: That specific academic groups cannot reproduce similar validation with their own implementations (Article XXXII).
C5_X_R1.what_failure_proves: C5-X does not survive clotFoam → KILL C5-X retroactively (Article XXVIII). OR C5-X does not beat all three baselines → KILL C5-X.
C5_X_R1.intermediate_outcome: If C5-X beats 2 of 3 baselines → INCONCLUSIVE → tighten experiment or public KILL.
C5_X_R1.prerequisite: All three baselines reproduced within 25% of published performance (Article XXIX). AND OpenFOAM-9 build completed for clotFoam independent reproduction.

C2_Y_R2_INDEPENDENT_REPRODUCTION.trigger: If C2-Y-R1 succeeds, generate C2-Y-R2 to satisfy Article XXVIII (independent reproduction).
C2_Y_R2_INDEPENDENT_REPRODUCTION.experiment: Re-run C2-Y on a different physics simulator (e.g., a different FSI solver, or external clinical dataset if available). Verify predictions match within pre-registered tolerance.
C2_Y_R2_INDEPENDENT_REPRODUCTION.what_success_proves: C2-Y is not over-fit to our internal World C simulator.
C2_Y_R2_INDEPENDENT_REPRODUCTION.what_failure_proves: C2-Y is over-fit → retroactive KILL (Article XXVIII).

C2_Y_R3_DESIGN_AROUND_ATTACK.trigger: If C2-Y-R1 + R2 succeed, generate C2-Y-R3 to test Article XVII (attempted bypass).
C2_Y_R3_DESIGN_AROUND_ATTACK.experiment: Construct a competitor design-around: simple threshold-on-response-deviation (no full response-manifold model). Test whether this simpler approach achieves similar lead time. If yes, C2-Y's moat is weak.
C2_Y_R3_DESIGN_AROUND_ATTACK.what_success_proves: If the simple design-around FAILS to achieve similar lead time, C2-Y's specific response-manifold method has moat.
C2_Y_R3_DESIGN_AROUND_ATTACK.what_failure_proves: If the simple design-around achieves similar lead time, C2-Y's moat is weak → re-evaluate patent strategy.

C3_X_R2_CLINICAL_VALIDATION_PATHWAY.trigger: If C3-X-R1 succeeds, generate C3-X-R2 to plan clinical validation (Article XXXIV — reality is the next bottleneck).
C3_X_R2_CLINICAL_VALIDATION_PATHWAY.experiment: Design a clinical trial protocol: virtual cohort → imaging-confirmed CSF drug concentration measurements → clinical outcomes. Pre-register with FDA.
C3_X_R2_CLINICAL_VALIDATION_PATHWAY.what_success_proves: C3-X has a viable clinical validation pathway.
C3_X_R2_CLINICAL_VALIDATION_PATHWAY.what_failure_proves: Clinical validation is infeasible → C3-X cannot progress to World-Class.

C3_X_R3_BUYER_ENGAGEMENT.trigger: If C3-X-R1 + R2 succeed, generate C3-X-R3 to test Q6 of moat loop (would they buy us).
C3_X_R3_BUYER_ENGAGEMENT.experiment: Engage Biogen (or acquire proxy: PK software vendor, neurology KOL) to assess acquisition interest. Pre-register a 'buyer fit' questionnaire.
C3_X_R3_BUYER_ENGAGEMENT.what_success_proves: Biogen (or proxy) expresses material acquisition interest.
C3_X_R3_BUYER_ENGAGEMENT.what_failure_proves: Buyer is not interested → re-evaluate acquisition thesis.

C5_X_R2_INTERVENTION_OPTIMIZATION_DEEPEN.trigger: If C5-X-R1 succeeds, generate C5-X-R2 to deepen intervention optimization.
C5_X_R2_INTERVENTION_OPTIMIZATION_DEEPEN.experiment: Test C5-X intervention recommendations against actual clinical intervention data (if available from collaborator) or against expert clinician judgment. Verify that C5-X recommendations align with expert decisions OR outperform them on simulated outcomes.
C5_X_R2_INTERVENTION_OPTIMIZATION_DEEPEN.what_success_proves: C5-X provides clinically meaningful intervention recommendations.
C5_X_R2_INTERVENTION_OPTIMIZATION_DEEPEN.what_failure_proves: C5-X recommendations diverge from expert judgment without outcome benefit → re-evaluate intervention optimization.

C5_X_R3_CLINICAL_DATA_VALIDATION.trigger: If C5-X-R1 + R2 succeed, generate C5-X-R3 to validate against real clinical data (Article XXXIV).
C5_X_R3_CLINICAL_DATA_VALIDATION.experiment: Acquire clinical thrombus imaging data (e.g., from MGH stroke service, if collaboration possible, or from public datasets like CLEVRER-medical, ISLES challenge). Run C5-X on real data; compare predictions to clinical outcomes.
C5_X_R3_CLINICAL_DATA_VALIDATION.what_success_proves: C5-X works on real clinical data.
C5_X_R3_CLINICAL_DATA_VALIDATION.what_failure_proves: C5-X does not generalize to real data → KILL.

the_principle.rule: Competitive intelligence is not a conclusion — it is a hypothesis generator. Every gap in public competitor capability generates a candidate experiment that tests whether our invention fills that gap. The experiment is the evidence; the competitive intelligence is the motivation.
the_principle.constitutional_anchor: Article I (evidence precedes assertion) + Article XXVIII (no silent semantic promotion) + Article XXXV (closed-loop epistemic control — experiments generate evidence that updates the model)
the_principle.anti_pattern: The anti-pattern is: 'VIEshunt does not publicly do prediction, therefore C2-Y is novel.' This is forbidden. The correct pattern is: 'VIEshunt does not publicly do prediction, THEREFORE we run C2-Y-R1 to test whether C2-Y's prediction works. If C2-Y-R1 succeeds, we have evidence that our approach works — but we do NOT have evidence that VIEshunt cannot do the same (Article XXXII).'
